06.notes: Detector delivers some samples in raw pixels, others already in cm-1. Per-sample `units` may be nm | cm-1 (default) | pixel. Pixel samples are mapped to cm-1 at load: neon-in-pixels -> pixel->nm + laser zeroing, else E1840 calibrants (si/pst/cal/apap)-in-pixels -> pixel->cm-1 directly. `axis_range_hint` (lo, hi in the target unit over the full pixel span) is recommended so lines are matched to the right bands when the detector reaches well beyond the calibrant lines.
